description: This header file defines the exported APIs for the COSA Library plugin, including initialization, support checks, and unload functions. It sets up the interface for a plugin component in the Cisco Open Service Architecture environment.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the COSA plugin with the maximum supported version and plugin info.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Performs cleanup and unloads the plugin.
